newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi Airlines sees return to sky before Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Airlines sees return to sky before Christmas.

text.p: Kiwi Airlines, which is presently bankrupt, said on Wednesday it expected to resume flying before Christmas, using eight of its 15 planes.

The carrier, whose operations were suspended on October 15, said it would make a further announcement on the matter at the end of next week. It said it expected to use 600 of its 1200 furloughed staff members when it resumed flying.
The company also said its previously announced $2.5 million installment of a $5 million debtor-in-possession financing plan came from a Florida-based shell company of investors called Wasatch Co.
The financing was presented on Wednesday in a U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Newark,N.J.
